A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to deliver a crate of goods to an [[O'reenian]] '''contact''' there. They had been hired by [[Unidentified O'reenian weapons smuggler|another O'reenian]], who had claimed the cargo merely consisted of luxury goods and sundries. The O'reenian authorities discovered the weapons cache, and the spacers had to negotiate to avoid arrest or [[Death/Legends|execution]]. Part of the deal they struck involved revealing the name of the O'reenian contact.<ref name="CSB">{{WizCite|book=The Unknown Regions|story=A Crateful of Smoking Blasters}}</ref>
